## math.geometry — 3D vectors, camera and projection

Does: Vector maths and a camera that projects 3D points to 2D screen coordinates.
Needs: Nothing.

Types:
- `Vec3(double X, double Y, double Z)` — A point or direction in three dimensions. · `Zero` · `Up` · `Length` · `Normalized()`
- `Camera3(Vec3 Position, Vec3 Target, Vec3 Up, double FieldOfViewDegrees)` — Where the viewer stands and what they are looking at. · `Default` · `Orbit(double radians)`
- `Projection3` — Turns world coordinates into panel coordinates, so a unit can draw in three dimensions with the two-dimensional primitives.
  - `Projection3.Of(Camera3 camera, double width, double height)`
- `Projected(double X, double Y, double Depth, bool InFront)` — One projected point, in panel pixels, with what a unit needs to draw it correctly.

Limits: Pure maths; drawing happens in the unit's page.
